title: Massage Start
summary: How the client is positioned at the start of massage, when they turn, and after mid-session — with head placement for the massage pillow.

sections.title: Client Positions
paragraphs: Know these four positions and use the correct one at each stage of the session.
list: Supine / dorsal position = lying on the back, face upward.
Prone / ventral position = lying on the stomach / front, face downward.
Left lateral position = lying on the left side.
Right lateral position = lying on the right side.

images.alt: Massage table positions: supine, prone, left lateral, and right lateral
images.caption: Client positions — supine, prone, left lateral, and right lateral

sections.title: When to Use Each Position
paragraphs: Follow this sequence during a Zura Massage session:
list: Start of massage: client lies prone (on the stomach / front).
When they turn: client moves to lateral (left or right side).
After mid-session: client lies dorsal / supine (on the back).

sections.title: Head Placement
paragraphs: The head should be faced down or tilted to the side, depending on the type of massage pillow.
Use the face cradle when the client is prone and the pillow type allows the head to face down. If the pillow requires it, tilt the head gently to the side for comfort and clear breathing.
Always check that the neck is comfortable, the airway is clear, and the client can breathe easily before you begin.
